description: Individual check_timestamp values were not recorded for the five pre-session and five post-session gauge-block readings in MAN-S001.
immediate_action: Preserve the ten observed gauge-block values as recorded; do not reconstruct or fabricate individual timestamps; record individual timestamps for all future reference-check readings.
data_affected: Documentation metadata only; no specimen measurements or reference-check values affected.
decision_basis: Administrative documentation deviation with no plausible measurement effect. Five pre-session and five post-session readings were obtained; all displayed 1.0000 in. Pre/post indication error, range, and drift passed frozen limits. Session start/end times and environmental observations were recorded.
notes: Identified after MAN-S001 and before opening MAN-S002.

description: During MAN-S002, frozen sequence 37 Part 222 was inadvertently skipped. Part 189 (frozen sequence 38) and Part 40 (frozen sequence 39) were therefore measured one position early.
immediate_action: Measurement was paused when the sequence displacement was recognized. The frozen run order was re-established beginning with sequence 37 Part 222, followed by Parts 189 and 40.
decision_basis: Frozen manual run order requires sequence 37 Part 222, sequence 38 Part 189, and sequence 39 Part 40. The two early measurements were retained as protocol-invalid records and replaced by correct-order measurements.
notes: No other MAN-S002 specimen observations were affected. Reference-system checks remained acceptable.
